description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, handling UI setup, permissions, lifecycle events, and communication with a ViewModel.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing app lifecycle, UI, permissions, and background services in an Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI, permissions, and lifecycle-aware coroutines.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles logic to run when activity starts, e.g., setting foreground status.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Handles cleanup or state updates when activity stops, e.g., clearing foreground status.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents received while activity is running, including assistant intent processing.

methods.name: handleAssistantIntent
methods.description: Parses and processes assistant launch intents.
